user.title: Incus
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should connect to your Incus server.

tls.title: Connect over TLS
tls.description: Connect to a remote Incus server using a trusted client certificate.

data_description.client_cert: The client certificate that has been trusted by the Incus server.
data_description.client_key: The private key matching the client certificate.
data_description.ca_cert: Optional custom CA used to verify the Incus server certificate. Leave empty to use the system trust store.

unix.title: Connect over Unix socket
unix.description: Connect to an Incus server running on the same host as Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Incus server.
error.invalid_auth: The Incus server does not trust this client certificate.
error.api_error: The Incus server returned an error.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Incus server is already configured.

data_description.all_projects: Discover instances and volumes from every Incus project, not just the default one.
data_description.enable_performance_sensors: Disable to keep only status/capacity sensors and reduce polling load.
